_comment: tests/ipad1/jank.py --gate thresholds. The metric is deterministic in virtual time (icount + vsync-stepped input): every recorded run read every frame on the next vsync, so any missed refresh fails. min_frames sits under the observed frame count to allow the swipe's tail (57-61). 'baseline' is the recorded verdict (qemu-ios 0a2fc35669 + jank-harness, 3.2.2 golden, iop-core=off).

home-swipe.baseline: 58 frames in 2 runs, p99 16.7 ms, 0 hitches (>=33 ms), longest 16.7 ms, 0 dropped
